# Security summary (SAFE NOW)

- Agents act within an authority that grows only as they show reliable results, and a person can override at any time.
- A small set of actions that cannot be undone (spending money, signing, deleting data without a backup, outside communication) always waits for a person.
- Every decision and result is recorded and reviewable.
- Changes are checked after release and rolled back automatically when a check fails.
- Credentials are kept in the cloud provider's secret store and never in code.
- Not yet available: independent security audit, certifications, multi-customer isolation. These are on the plan and will be disclosed when done.

Security contact: pilot@ultrastable.io (interim).
